story.title: Why We Started This
story.description1: In 2021, our founder left behind his grandmother's traditional kitchen to chase his dreams in the city. But nothing compared to the way grandma cooked—with love, care, and the finest ingredients. That longing inspired us to bring that same authentic, home-cooked experience to thousands of people.
story.description2: Today, we operate a licensed, hygienic kitchen where every meal is prepared with the same passion and attention to detail as if it were for our own family. We believe good food should be accessible, affordable, and absolutely delicious.
story.storyPoint1Desc: Began when our founder craved the warmth of home-cooked meals after moving to the city.
story.storyPoint2Desc: Every dish is made using 30+ year old family recipes passed down through generations.
story.storyPoint3Desc: Only the finest, farm-fresh ingredients. No preservatives, no artificial flavors.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Get quick answers to common queries
faq.q1: Is the food spicy? Can I customize the spice level?
faq.a1: Most of our dishes are medium to high spice. However, we understand different preferences. You can always add special instructions during checkout to request mild, medium, or hot preparations. Our delivery partner will add a note with your order.
faq.q2: Do you use packaged masalas or fresh spices?
faq.a2: We use a blend of fresh ground spices and premium quality masala powders. All our masalas are sourced from certified suppliers, and we grind them fresh daily to ensure maximum flavor and freshness.
faq.q3: How do you ensure veg and non-veg separation?
faq.a3: We maintain strict segregation between vegetarian and non-vegetarian items. Different utensils, cutting boards, and preparation areas are used. Our FSSAI certification ensures compliance with all food safety regulations.
faq.a4: Orders can be cancelled within 5 minutes of placement for a full refund. After that, it depends on the preparation status. In case of quality issues, we provide replacements or full refunds. Contact us immediately after delivery if there are any concerns.
faq.q5: Can I pre-order meals? What about bulk orders?
faq.a5: Yes! You can pre-order meals up to 24 hours in advance. For bulk orders (10+ meals), please WhatsApp us directly for special pricing and customization. We handle corporate orders and event catering.
faq.q6: How do you maintain food quality during delivery?
faq.a6: We use insulated, temperature-controlled containers for all deliveries. Our packaging is food-safe and designed to keep meals hot and fresh. All orders are dispatched within 5 minutes of preparation to minimize delivery time.
faq.contactDesc: Our customer service team is ready to help! Reach out to us on WhatsApp for instant support.
